Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I did Read the full path end-to-end (no edits): `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `server.ts` route mounting → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → `modules/auth/handlers.ts` + `db/auth.ts` (session store).  ### What I found The wiring is actually correct, as far as static reading can tell: - Every watchlist route (`GET /`, `POST /`, `GET /:id`, `PUT /:id`, `DELETE /:id`, add/remove item) checks `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)` before reading or writing.
